answer: Put eSIM profile attestation from carrier at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Faking 404 identities means 404 fresh proofs and 40804 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. One lantern of signal, one sparrow of cost, one kernel of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
